Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import numpy as np
def comps(g,bg):
    g=np.array(g); h,w=g.shape; seen=np.zeros((h,w),bool); out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r,c]!=bg and not seen[r,c]:
                st=[(r,c)];comp=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if a<0 or b<0 or a>=h or b>=w or seen[a,b] or g[a,b]==bg: continue
                    seen[a,b]=True; comp.append((a,b))
                    for dr in(-1,0,1):
                        for dc in(-1,0,1): st.append((a+dr,b+dc))
                out.append(comp)
    return out

    inp=[''.join(str(int(I[r][c])) if (r,c) in S else '.' for c in range(c0,c1+1)) for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    outp=[]
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):

    for p,q in zip(inp,outp): print(p,'|',q)

import numpy as np
def comps(g, bg=None):
    g=np.array(g); seen=np.zeros_like(g,bool); out=[]
    H,W=g.shape
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r,c]!=bg and not seen[r,c]:
                col=int(g[r,c]); st=[(r,c)]; comp=[]; seen[r,c]=True
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny,nx] and g[ny,nx]==col:
                            seen[ny,nx]=True; st.append((ny,nx))
                out.append((col,tuple(sorted(comp))))
    return out

def solve(I):
    I=np.array(I); H,W=I.shape
    bg=Counter(I.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(I,bg)
    multis=[(col,c) for col,c in cs if len(c)>1]
    seeds=[(col,c) for col,c in cs if len(c)==1]
    O=I.copy()
    def draw(cells,color):
        for r,c in cells:
            if 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and O[r,c]==bg: O[r,c]=color
    for col,s in seeds:
        # nearest multi-object by min manhattan dist from seed to any cell
        best=min(multis,key=lambda m:min(abs(r-s[0])+abs(c-s[1]) for r,c in m[1]))
        T=best[1]; mr=[r for r,c in T]; mc=[c for r,c in T]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(mr),max(mr),min(mc),max(mc)
        if s[1]<c0: ax=c0-0.5; orient='hm'
        elif s[1]>c1: ax=c1+0.5; orient='hm'
        elif s[0]<r0: ax=r0-0.5; orient='vm'
        elif s[0]>r1: ax=r1+0.5; orient='vm'
        else:
            cr = r0-0.5 if s[0]<=r0 else r1+0.5
            cc = c0-0.5 if s[1]<=c0 else c1+0.5
            orient='pt'
        cells=[]
        if orient=='hm': cells=[(r,int(2*ax-c)) for r,c in T]
        elif orient=='vm': cells=[(int(2*ax-r),c) for r,c in T]
        else:
            cells=[(int(2*cr-r),int(2*cc-c)) for r,c in T]
        draw(cells,col)
    return O.tolist()

ok=True
for i in range(1,9):
    Ii=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; Oi=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {i} output'])
    P=np.array(solve(Ii))
    m=(P!=Oi).sum()
    print(i,'mismatches:',m)
    ok &= m==0
print('ALL OK' if ok else 'MISMATCH')

import numpy as np, json
def cc(I,bg):
    I=np.array(I); seen=np.zeros_like(I,bool); out=[]
    H,W=I.shape
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r,c]!=bg and not seen[r,c]:
                col=int(I[r,c]); st=[(r,c)]; seen[r,c]=True; cells=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); cells.append((int(y),int(x)))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny,nx] and I[ny,nx]==col:
                            seen[ny,nx]=True; st.append((ny,nx))
                out.append((col,tuple(cells)))
    return out
def normshape(s):
    my=min(y for y,x in s); mx=min(x for y,x in s)
    return sorted((y-my,x-mx) for y,x in s)

# For demo5: template shape Trel (from big comp). Seeds colors 7,6,1 at positions p. Output: each seed's copy of template appears somewhere.

                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); cells.append((int(y),int(x)))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny,nx] and I[ny,nx]==col:
                            seen[ny,nx]=True; st.append((ny,nx))
                out.append((col,tuple(cells)))
    return out

def solve(inp):

            if best is None or key<best[0]: best=(key,ti)

        ncell=min(t,key=lambda q:(max(abs(p[0]-q[0]),abs(p[1]-q[1]))))
        dy=1 if p[0]>ncell[0] else -1

import numpy as np
def growinfo(dn):
    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {dn} input']); O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {dn} output'])
    bg=int(Counter(I.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0])

    rem=[(r,c,int(I[r][c])) for r in range(I.shape[0]) for c in range(I.shape[1]) if I[r][c]!=bg and O[r][c]==bg]
    print('demo',dn,'adds',len(add),'rems',rem)
    return I,O,bg,ci,seeds

            for vv in variants([(y-min(a for a,_ in st),x-min(b for _,b in st)) for y,x in st]):
                vs=set(vv)
                sy=min(y for y,_ in Q)-min(y for y,_ in vv); sx=min(x for _,x in Q)-min(x for _,x in vv)
                cand=frozenset((y+sy,x+sx) for y,x in vv)
                if cand==Q:
                    found=('exact',ti,tuple(sorted(vv)),(sy,sx)); break
            if found and found[0]=='exact': break
        out.append((si,pos,I[pos[0],pos[1]],sorted(Q),found,len(Q)))

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def norm(cells):
    m=min(cells); return tuple(sorted((y-m[0],x-m[1]) for y,x in cells))
def diheds(st):
    res=[]; seen=set(); cur=tuple(norm(st))
    def rot(p): return [(x,-y) for y,x in p]
    def mir(p): return [(y,-x) for y,x in p]
    c=cur
    for _ in range(4):
        for v in (c, mir(c)):
            k=tuple(v)
            if k not in seen: seen.add(k); res.append(k)
        c=rot(c)
    return res

            # brute force over variants too
            tvs=diheds(trec)
            base=set(norm(st)) if False else None
            cands=set()
            for v in tvs:
                hy=max(y for y,_ in v)+1; wx=max(x for _,x in v)+1
                for ty in range(Ht-hy+1):
                    for tx in range(Wt-wx+1):
                        q=tuple((y+ty,x+tx) for y,x in v)

import numpy as np, re, os
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# Focus on small-change demos 7 and 8. Demo 8 diffs:
I=np.array(G['Demo pair 8 input']);O=np.array(G['Demo pair 8 output'])
for r in range(I.shape[0]):
    li=''.join('.' if v==int(Counter(I.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]) else str(int(v)) for v in I[r])
    lo=''.join('.' if v==int(Counter(O.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]) else str(int(v)) for v in O[r])
    print(f'{r:2d}',li,' ',lo)
print('ndiff cells:')

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

def maximal_rects(g):
    g=np.array(g);H,W=g.shape
    cnt=Counter(g.flatten());bg=int(cnt.most_common(1)[0][0])
    pts={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r,c]!=bg}
    res=[];used=set()
    for r0 in range(H):
        for c0 in range(W):
            if (r0,c0) in used or (r0,c0) not in pts: continue
            col=int(g[r0,c0])
            hmax=max(r for r in range(r0,H) if all((rr,c0) in pts and g[rr,c0]==col for rr in range(r0,r+1)))
            wmax=max(c for c in range(c0,W) if all((r0,cc) in pts and g[r0,cc]==col for cc in range(c0,c+1)))
            best=None
            for hh in range(1,hmax+1):
                for ww in range(1,wmax+1):
                    ok=all((r,c) in pts and g[r,c]==col for r in range(r0,r0+hh) for c in range(c0,c0+ww))
                    if ok:
                        area=hh*ww
                        if best is None or area>best[0]: best=(area,r0,c0,hh,ww,col)
            if best is None: continue
            _,r0,c0,hh,ww,col=best
            ext=False
            if r0+hh<H and all((r,c0) in pts and g[r,c0]==col for r in range(r0+hh,min(H,r0+hmax+1))): ext=True
            elif c0+ww<W and all((r0,c) in pts and g[r0,c]==col for c in range(c0+ww,min(W,c0+wmax+1))): ext=True
            elif hh>1 and all((r,c0) in pts and g[r,c0]==col for r in range(r0-hh,r0)): ext=True
            elif ww>1 and all((r0,c) in pts and g[r0,c]==col for c in range(c0-ww,c0)): ext=True
            if ext: continue
            used.add((r0,c0)); res.append((r0,c0,hh,ww,col))
    return res
